title: Wavelength
description: An enhanced multiplayer experience for Minecraft.
body:
![Bring your SMP to life.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/82ed8ceb1c3fe899ecfb321e3acd515f85a14ea1.png)

Nameplates, ranks, friends, projects, and live events, all synced through your own server.




![Cool Nameplates](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15f32882d66695097f71021900ddd99139b6dacd.png) Rank, town, live activity, and badges, shown above every player. Unlock nameplate designs by earning badges and wear the one you like.

![nameplate prev](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e5f6d0e7d01cfbf8b8577502bd620ae6e68bedc.png)



![One menu, everything](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94a3b32c183040ba59fef4ec0bc4fe2d84340b71.png) Players, friends, stats, leaderboards, projects, and events. ![Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2308f32f7cbbe8cdc2499b61b592d31feeebb311_0.webp)


![Build Together](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e9ff3636ea2dd34f35dce7a837b05e0fe60ea0e7.png) Start projects, invite collaborators, and track progress as a team. ![Projects](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de316aaea5283f103cb49a25ed9beecde6119cc7_0.webp)


![Events and dimension gates](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/531e30ac673f33433ff0409f80553c5da881d6c0.png) Run live server events and open or close the Nether and End on a schedule. ![Events](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6ee76ace361e74a00609c6edf2d2b3a228872d56.png)
Full feature list (click to expand)
**Nameplates** - Rank and town shown above each player (like *Mayor of Riverside*) - Live activity shown with an icon (Mining, Building, Fighting, Farming) - Achievement badge shown next to the name - Privacy shown as a small icon (Public, Friends, Ghost) - A flourish plays on the nameplate when someone levels up - Show your own nameplate in third person, with or without custom nameplates - Can be turned off to fall back to vanilla nameplates **Nameplate designs** - Pick how your nameplate looks: 20 designs, each a border shape and a colour theme - Designs are unlocked by earning badges, never applied automatically - The Nameplate tab shows what each design needs and how close you are, with filters and a sort by what you are nearest to earning - Seven border animations: Glint, Comet, Pulse, Rainbow, Shimmer, Sparkle, or none - Unlock every design to earn Prismatic, a custom plate with your own background, border, text and effect colours, plus your own shape and animation - Your design is visible to everyone on the server - Unlocks come from your stats on each server, so a design is earned and worn per server **Your profile and identity** - Set your own town name and pick a rank - 12 ranks: Founder, King, Queen, Mayor, Knight, Guard, Builder, Farmer, Miner, Citizen, Traveler, Developer - Three privacy modes: Public, Friends Only, and Ghost (hides your activity and location) - PVP mode toggle that hides your activity from others - Write a short description about yourself - Add playstyle tags (presets like PVP, Building, Redstone, Trading, or your own custom ones) **The menu (press H)** - A resizable window you can maximize, with tabs for Players, Stats, Leaderboard, Projects, Events, Friends, Town, Nameplate, Timeline, and Settings - Pick your own accent color - Clean custom interface with a rotatable 3D skin view on profiles **Players** - See everyone online, sorted by distance, with the direction and range to each player even when they are far away or in another dimension - See everyone who has ever joined the server in an offline list - Search the roster by name - Open any player to view their profile: skin, description, tags, stats, and badges - Privacy is respected (Friends Only and Ghost hide details from people who should not see them) **Friends** - Send, accept, decline, and cancel friend requests, with alerts - A confirmed friends list you can remove people from - Friends are highlighted with a green outline in the player list **Stats and badges** - Tracks blocks mined and placed, mobs killed, damage dealt, crops harvested, items crafted, distance travelled, and playtime - Total and current-session playtime - Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Diamond badges across mining, building, combat, farming, crafting, and exploring - Progress bars showing how close you are to the next tier - Badges unlock nameplate designs; click a tier medallion to jump straight to them **Leaderboard** - Ranks players in each category, plus playtime - Trophies and highlights for the top three **Projects** - Start a build project and share it on the server board - Solo or Team, with Public, Friends Only, or Private visibility - Break a project into subprojects, each with its own progress - Track progress by hand, or let it fill in automatically from subprojects - Others can request to join a Team project; you accept or decline, and can remove members - Mark a project complete for a server-wide celebration **Events and dimensions** - Create server events with a name, description, optional start delay, and duration - Live and upcoming lists with countdowns, plus an optional event location - One-time events that fire once and disappear - Server operators can open or close the Nether and the End for everyone - An event can be linked to a dimension so it opens or closes when the event begins **Timeline** - A server-wide feed of project and event milestones and badge unlocks - Each entry is clickable and jumps to the related page or player **In-game HUD** - A top bar showing your identity (privacy and rank/town), nearby players, and the active event - A full editor to drag elements around, snap them, change their anchor, resize each one, adjust opacity, and hide the ones you do not want - Elements snap to each other and to the screen, and never overlap at any HUD or GUI scale **Notifications** - Pop-up toasts for feedback, friend requests, project updates, events, badge unlocks, and operator broadcasts - Adjustable size, position, duration, and sound, and each type can be turned off - Server operators can broadcast a message to everyone **Server and compatibility** - Everything is saved on the server, so your profile, projects, and events survive restarts and follow you to a new computer - Update reminder when your version is behind the server, and an update check that matches your Minecraft version and mod loader - Players on a vanilla client still appear in the roster and receive key messages in chat
